intro.text: A singer, head of farming for the listeners.

items.text: During the war on the Shattered Plains, Venli recruited Denshil to her plan to rediscover stormform. As a farmer he had access to uncut gemhearts; Ulim taught him to cut them into faceted gemstones, which he told the other farmers stored Stormlight better. Secretly he hoarded extra gems for Venli, reluctant since farming needed them, but Venli played on his wish to protect his children.

By late 1173 Venli wanted more. When he balked at cutting the gems even smaller, she said they were saving his daughter from the humans. He gave in but asked her to tell the Five; she lied that she would, and he left to cut a newly captured gemheart.

appearance.text: Scrawny despite his workform, with rough black and red skin patterns like marblework.

personality.text: Uncomfortable with subterfuge, he grows very nervous conspiring with Venli without the Five's knowledge, and she manipulates him easily through his fears.
